questions.text: The scaffold user removed the diagonal tie to carry material. How to proceed?

options.text: Immediately cease use of the site and restore the structure by authorized project personnel.
Leave the connection disconnected until the end of the shift.
Replace the connection with a rope.
Allow operation if there is only one person on the deck.

questions.text: A scaffolding base plate has been set on loose ground without a sole board. What is required?

options.text: Place a random brick under one side of the slab.
Increase the load on the stand to compact the soil.
Compact the soil with your foot around the post.
Stop installation and prepare a stable foundation according to the design and system passport.

questions.text: After strong winds there is no visible damage from the ground. Is it possible to resume work immediately?

options.text: Yes, if you reduce the amount of materials on the flooring.
Yes, if working platform is dry.
No; the scaffolding must undergo an extraordinary inspection by a competent person before it is authorized for use.
Yes, if workers use hard hats.

questions.text: At working platform materials are stored in excess of the specified permissible load. What to do?

options.text: Distribute the load at one edge of the deck.
Stop loading immediately and adjust the load to the design and scaffolding status.
Remove some of the ties to expand the space.
Allow overload for a short time.

questions.text: Why is scaffolding attached to a structure?

options.text: To replace all diagonal braces.
To increase the width of the deck without calculation.
For tier height indication only.
To ensure the calculated spatial stability according to the design and installation diagram.

questions.text: What should the worker working platform be like?

options.text: Continuous within specified limits, stable, secured and without dangerous gaps or damage.
Inclined to the outer edge for water drainage.
Loosely stowed for quick removal.
Compiled from any scraps of different thicknesses.

questions.text: Which fall protection measure has priority when installing scaffolding?

options.text: Installer's personal discretion only.
Only a hard hat, with no guardrails or fall-arrest system.
Provided collective protection technology, complemented by a fall arrest system where required.
Verbal height warning.

questions.text: What is the correct sequence for admitting scaffolding to operation?

options.text: Check only the bottom tier and open all levels.
Install markings without inspecting the structure.
Allow operation, then check scaffolding at end of shift.
Complete installation according to the diagram, have it checked by a competent person, record the result and indicate the status.

questions.text: What is a safe sequence for scaffold removal?

options.text: Disassemble unrelated areas at the same time without guidance.
According to the approved scheme in the reverse technological sequence while maintaining stability and fencing the area.
First remove all anchors, then dismantle the decking.
Throw elements down into a fenced area.

questions.text: Who is a competent person when working with scaffolding?

options.text: Any user who reached working platform first.
worker, which only transfers materials.
Assigned worker with the necessary knowledge and authority for the assigned reviews and decisions.
Any visitor to a construction site.

questions.text: A worker without the required authorization proposes changing the working-platform height. What should be done?

options.text: Allow if no tools are used.
Remove the guard to speed up the transfer.
Do not allow changes; Installation and relocation is carried out by designated trained personnel.
Allow modification under verbal supervision of a colleague.

questions.text: After rain, the ground beneath the scaffolding base has subsided. What should be done?

options.text: Continue working until the end of the shift.
Close access, unload the area using a safe procedure and carry out inspection and restoration of the base.
Knock out wedges while people are on the deck.
Add materials to the opposite side.

questions.text: Ice has formed on the decking. How to proceed?

options.text: Sprinkle sawdust on the ice as you continue working.
Move faster so as not to be delayed.
Remove the handrail for easy cleaning.
Stop use of the area until the slip is safely corrected and conditions are reassessed.

questions.text: A loose board was found in the decking. What should I do?

options.text: Cover area and secure or replace working platform by authorized personnel prior to use.
Press the board with materials.
Warn workers to step over the dangerous area.
Turn the board over and continue working.

questions.text: Is it possible to determine the pitch of anchors using one universal number?

options.text: Yes, if the scaffolding is lower than the adjacent building.
No; parameters are taken according to the project, the manufacturer’s passport and the diagram of a specific system.
Yes, one number is suitable for all scaffolds.
Yes, if the facade is made of concrete.

questions.text: How is safe access to the scaffolding tiers arranged?

options.text: On the outside of frames without special means.
By diagonal connections.
By lifting on a loading platform not intended for people.
Along the provided stairs or flight of stairs with proper fastening and a protected opening.

questions.text: A fall-arrest anchor point has been selected on an arbitrary scaffolding member. What should be done?

options.text: Connect the harness to your colleague’s belt.
Ignore possible free fall.
Use only the planned and calculated attachment point, taking into account the headroom.
Secure to the nearest handrail without checking.

questions.text: What does the inspection after an alteration to the scaffolding include?

options.text: Check the top handrail only.
Inspection of the base, elements, connections, fastenings, decking, fences and access with status recording.
Checking the color of the marking only.
Checking only the number of employees.

questions.text: The scaffolding is marked “do not use”. What to do?

options.text: Do not enter the scaffolding and wait for the reasons to be eliminated and a new permit by a competent person.
Use only the lower tier.
Remove marking after verbal permission from colleague.
Work without materials, maintaining markings.

questions.text: What is the side fencing element needed for?

options.text: To increase the permissible load of scaffolding.
To replace the middle handrail in all cases.
For securing electrical cables.
To reduce the risk of objects and worker feet slipping over the edge of the deck.

questions.text: After the scaffolding was put into operation, the user noticed a missing element. Which action is correct?

options.text: Move to the next span without reporting the defect.
Stop use, secure the area and report to a competent person for inspection.
Replace the element yourself with any suitable profile.
Continue work without posting materials.

questions.text: Stand mounted on a set of loose scraps. Which decision is correct?

options.text: Secure the scraps with wire and leave.
Add sand on one side only.
Rebuild the support using the provided base elements on the prepared base.
Consider the support acceptable in the absence of wind.

questions.text: During work, visibility deteriorated and the wind increased. What should a leader do?

options.text: Assess conditions and stop work if safe operation and stability are not ensured.
Remove signal barriers to prevent them from being torn down.
Allow work without moving materials.
Continue working on the upper tier only.

questions.text: There is no side element on the tier, and people are working below. Which action is correct?

options.text: Move materials closer to the edge to clear the passage.
Continue if the tool is in your pockets.
Give a verbal warning without fencing the area.
Stop work, eliminate people below and restore protection against falling objects.

questions.text: What should you do with a loose clamp or connection?

options.text: Pull it up while people are on the deck.
Replace the clamp with wire.
Stop use of the affected area and restore connection through the system, followed by testing.
Leave until scheduled dismantling.

questions.text: What must be taken into account when constructing a deck fencing?

options.text: Continuity of handrails, intermediate protection and side elements according to the design and scaffolding system.
Only having one rope on the outside.
Only the height of the nearest wall.
Top rail color only.

questions.text: Scaffolding is located next to the electrical installation. How to proceed?

options.text: Move long elements over wires manually.
Observe the established safe distances and protective measures according to the plan, excluding the approach of elements and people.
Consider metal scaffolding as protective ground without testing.
Continue working with the lighting turned off.

questions.text: When is an extraordinary inspection required?

options.text: Only after complete dismantling.
Only before holidays.
Following change, damage, subsidence, adverse weather or other event likely to affect safety.
Only when changing the color of the facade.

questions.text: During dismantling, a deformed element was found. What should I do?

options.text: Hide the element in the general pack.
Use it as a temporary support pad.
Straighten with a blow and immediately install in another area.
Separate it from serviceable elements, label it and send it for designated rejection or evaluation.

questions.text: What does scaffold anchoring mean?

options.text: The connection of the scaffolding with the structure provided for in the project, ensuring their stability.
Permissible load marking on the decking.
Any rope between two posts.
Underlay for base plate.
